fluff.overview: The Blessed Order maintained conventional infantry formations equipped with preserved Star League-era weapons and personal armor, fielding platoons that were better armed than most Successor State infantry throughout the late Succession Wars. Mechanized hover platoons are among the fastest conventional infantry formations fielded, using hovercraft transports that can cross water and open terrain at speeds that wheeled and tracked vehicles cannot match. ComStar favored hover-mechanized infantry for rapid response assignments where speed of deployment outweighed the need for heavy protection. Armed with man-portable flamers that project streams of ignited fuel, these troops carry one of the most psychologically devastating weapons available to conventional infantry, effective at clearing fortified positions and enclosed spaces at the cost of extreme danger to the operator.
